junkville/findHelpful.title: Missing colt
junkville/findHelpful.tell-parents: Break up the news to the parents
junkville/findHelpful.description: That young colt you met earlier in Junkville disappeared. That's really none of your business, but you could take a look still. With those short legs of his, he can't have gone too far.
junkville/findHelpful.desc-found-helpful: You found the child. He didn't go very far indeed. It seems like he fell down the well, and ended up dwown in the undergrounds.
junkville/findHelpful.desc-helpful-died: Here's the thing though : he's dead. It's never easy to break up the news to the family.
junkville/findHelpful.desc-helpful-save: Thanks to your help, the young colt made it out safe and sound, and is now reunited with his loving family.
